GenAiPlugin.description: Monitor and update volunteer availability in real time. This topic is selected when there is a need to check or update the current availability of volunteers.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about updating volunteer availability, use sfdc_fieldservice__AssignApptForServiceResourceForFieldService.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only track and update real-time availability of volunteers. This includes monitoring current status and updating availability information.
